title: 集合运算
objective: 合并结果集并掌握去重、交集与差集。

knowledgePoints.title: 结果集合合并
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 根据业务键与来源追踪需求选择保留重复或整行去重。
knowledgePoints.concept: 集合合并是纵向叠加查询结果，不是横向连接字段。各分支列数相同、位置及业务含义对应。UNION ALL 保留全部行，UNION 对全部输出列去重，包括同样的空值组合。添加来源列会改变整行去重规则；如需保留来源又按客户去重，应另按客户汇总。整个集合的排序写在末尾。
knowledgePoints.syntax: SELECT col FROM a UNION [ALL] SELECT col FROM b ORDER BY col;

parameters.col: 位置及语义对应的字段

columns.name: customer_name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: customer_name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM old_customers UNION ALL SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_name;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM old_customers UNION ALL SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_name;
executionSteps: 确认两个名单的输出字段
knowledgePoints.useCase: 客户运营要合并新旧两批名单。旧名单4行，新名单3行；编号2重复录入且跨批出现，编号3跨批出现。统计唯一客户时以客户编号为键。
knowledgePoints.comparison: 连接按条件组合列；集合合并按列位置叠加行。

commonError.example: 加入来源字段后仍以 UNION 期待每客户唯一。
commonError.correction: 仅输出客户键去重，或外层按客户键聚合。

knowledgePoints.notes: 原生与本地隐式类型、文本排序及混合集合优先级可能不同。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

teaching.problem: 客户运营要合并新旧两批名单。旧名单4行，新名单3行；编号2重复录入且跨批出现，编号3跨批出现。统计唯一客户时以客户编号为键。
teaching.codeExplanation: 主查询使用 UNION ALL，故不改变输入记录的重复次数；改为 UNION 后对编号与姓名的组合去重。如果需要知道来自哪一批，在分支中显式加来源标签并另外做客户级统计。末尾 ORDER BY 对整个组合结果生效，不是仅排序后一批。
teaching.resultExplanation: 保留重复时7行；唯一客户清单4行。编号2出现3次并不证明其有3次消费，名单记录不是订单。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 保留整行去重、来源标签影响与唯一客户判断。
补充末尾排序范围及分支封装；主体差集教学仍归13-02。

mergeExamples.label: 唯一客户清单
mergeExamples.explanation: 合并来源课程的原查询，按整行（单列编号）去重。
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM old_customers UNION SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_name;

mergeExamples.label: 带来源的合并
mergeExamples.explanation: 客户2、3的来源不同，整行不同，仍会保留跨来源记录。
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT customer_id,customer_name,'old' AS source FROM old_customers UNION SELECT customer_id,customer_name,'new' AS source FROM new_customers ORDER BY source DESC, customer_name;

mergeExamples.label: 先限制分支再整体排序
mergeExamples.explanation: 先选旧名单编号最高的一条，然后合并新名单；最终排序独立于分支排序。
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM (SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM old_customers ORDER BY customer_name DESC LIMIT 1) AS a UNION ALL SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_name;

knowledgePoints.title: 交集与差集
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 比较两个名单的共同成员、单侧成员，并理解差集方向。
knowledgePoints.concept: 交集返回两个结果中共同存在的行；差集返回左侧存在且右侧不存在的行。默认均去重。差集不可交换左右侧；交集的成员不取决于方向。集合运算比较对应的整行，不等于普通等号处理空值的逻辑。原生 MySQL 8.4 支持两类运算，SQLite 不支持其 ALL 形式；组合运算宜用具名表达式明确范围。
knowledgePoints.syntax: SELECT col FROM a INTERSECT SELECT col FROM b; SELECT col FROM a EXCEPT SELECT col FROM b;

columns.name: customer_name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: customer_name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM old_customers INTERSECT SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_name;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM old_customers INTERSECT SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_name;
executionSteps: 确定新旧名单的比较键
knowledgePoints.useCase: 对比两期客户名单，识别两期共同出现、仅旧名单出现及仅新名单出现的客户。不直接将名单差异断言为真实流失或新增消费。
knowledgePoints.comparison: INTERSECT 找共同项；EXCEPT 有明确方向。

commonError.example: 把差集写成寻找共同客户，或认为交换两侧不改变结果。
commonError.correction: 选用 INTERSECT 找共同项；差集分别运行两个方向。

knowledgePoints.notes: 混用不同集合运算时先封装为独立查询，避免引擎优先级差异。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

teaching.problem: 对比两期客户名单，识别两期共同出现、仅旧名单出现及仅新名单出现的客户。不直接将名单差异断言为真实流失或新增消费。
teaching.codeExplanation: INTERSECT 在两边都存在的编号中去重。EXCEPT 先规定左侧基准，再排除右侧出现者；改变顺序即可计算另一方向。末尾 ORDER BY 为整体排序。若旧系统不支持集合运算，可按业务键使用 EXISTS 或 NOT EXISTS，并处理去重与空值规则。
teaching.resultExplanation: 共同编号2、3；仅旧名单编号1，仅新名单编号4。重复旧编号2并不改变默认交集结果。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 完整保留差集方向、整体排序和原始差集示例。

mergeExamples.label: 旧名单独有
mergeExamples.explanation: 保留来源课程原差集查询。
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM old_customers EXCEPT SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_name;

mergeExamples.label: 新名单独有
mergeExamples.explanation: 交换左右侧得到另一方向。
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM new_customers EXCEPT SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM old_customers ORDER BY customer_name;
